note_value: Main-window only (<=150 ka), using existing clean workflow outputs for retained taxa/modules/HMM states.
Damaged-read relative abundance computed across retained taxa per sample; module-level TEA uses within-sample, within-module normalized weights.
KO-first TEA logic retained; module-completeness fallback used when KO evidence unavailable.
Primary module centering and enrichment tests include grey; exclude-grey sensitivity outputs are also exported.
TEA indices represent annotation-weighted genomic potential, not direct in situ activity.
HMM states are reused from 03_hmm_main outputs; states are not refit in this TEA stage.
Taxon-level OAP and metabolic calls are annotation-derived trait proxies (genomic potential), not measured metabolic activity.
